work: Post-Phase-15 Validation & Effect-Verification Closure (bounded slice; not Phase 16)

goals.P0-1: Replace synthetic effect verification with observed browser state
goals.P0-2: Prove a genuine real-reasoner -> real-Chrome autonomous run end-to-end

P0-1_effectVerification.defect: getEffectSnapshot was optional and the service worker never implemented it, so BOTH pre and post snapshots were synthesized inside agentLoop.ts from the REQUESTED action. For navigate, newUrl = action.url; for scroll, newScrollY += delta; for type, newValLen = action.text.length; for click, newDomCount += 1. verifyActionEffect() therefore could not fail for a successful dispatch in production.
P0-1_effectVerification.reuseNotRedesign: The existing PreActionSnapshot / PostActionSnapshot contract and verifyActionEffect() were reused unchanged. No new effect-verification semantics were introduced.

changes.change: Added collectEffectSnapshot(), countOpenModals(), describeActiveElement() and a dedicated PRIVAGENT_GET_EFFECT_SNAPSHOT / PRIVAGENT_GET_EFFECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE message. Reports url, scrollX, scrollY, openModalsCount, activeElementSelector, domElementCount and the target's value LENGTH only.
Added the snapshot request/response variants to ExtensionMessage.

Implemented getEffectSnapshot(target?): queries the pinned target tab, reads the URL from Chrome's own tab record (survives content-script teardown mid-navigation), validates the response shape, and returns null on any failure. 2s tab-URL timeout, 3s content-script timeout.

Added observeEffectSnapshot(target, phase). PRE may fall back for a host with no tab; POST fails CLOSED as ACTION_NO_EFFECT with an EFFECT_UNVERIFIABLE reason, bounded by the existing retry budget. The previous derive-post-state-from-the-request fallback is no longer reachable when a host has an observation channel. getEffectSnapshot signature gained an optional target parameter (backward compatible).

privacy.activeElementIdentity: derived tag:nth-child(n), never the site-supplied raw id

P0-1_tests.delta: +17 tests, +1 file; no existing test weakened or deleted

P0-1_realChrome.extension: REAL built dist/ loaded via Extensions.loadUnpacked
P0-1_realChrome.verifier: verifyActionEffect bundled from extension/src (shipped code, not a reimplementation)

negativeCase.scenario: scroll at the document scroll boundary
negativeCase.dispatchMessage: Scroll produced no viewport movement (boundary reached).
negativeCase.significance: The dispatch was acknowledged, the browser did not move, and the verdict says so — from observation, not from the request. This state was unreachable under the previous synthesized post-snapshot.

positiveControl.note: The observed delta produced the verdict, not the requested amount.

subtleControl.note: A genuine, subtle observed effect is still reported as an effect. Guards against over-correcting into treating everything as a no-op.

typeControl.note: Only the LENGTH crossed the boundary; the typed value never appears in any snapshot.
